I fixed the typo with a new migration, `migrations/0008_fix_customers.sql`, rather than editing 0007:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

Editing in place until release can work in some setups, but here 0007 has already run in production. Changing the file now wouldn't rename the column there, and the schema would no longer match the migration history. The project rule is to add a new numbered migration instead, so that's what I did.

I searched the codebase and nothing else uses `emial`, so no code needs updating. I haven't run the migration.
